title: Slime Kits
description: This plugin adds kit pvp functionality to the game. When a player dies they respawn with gear.
body: This is a kitpvp  plugin free to use. This plugin is used in the slimecraft.org server and is free to use. This plugin gives gear to players upon death including armor, shield, totem, axe, sword, lava and water buckets, blocks etc. If you have any suggestions as to what should be added next feel free to add pentagn on discord.
